rotate-first-page-pdf.title: Rotate First Page of PDF Using PdfPageEditor
rotate-first-page-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfPageEditor, selecting the first page, rotating it 90 degrees, and saving the edited document.

rotate-first-page-from-memory-stream.title: In-Memory PDF Page Editing with Aspose.Pdf
rotate-first-page-from-memory-stream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a MemoryStream, performing basic page manipulations such as deleting and adding pages, and saving the result using Aspose.Pdf.

edit-pdf-page-zoom-save.title: Delete First Page and Rotate Second Page in PDF
edit-pdf-page-zoom-save.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, deleting the first page, rotating the second page 90° clockwise, and saving the edited document to a new file using Aspose.Pdf.

edit-pdf-in-memory-using-pdfpageeditor.title: Rotate PDF Page In-Memory Using PdfPageEditor
edit-pdf-in-memory-using-pdfpageeditor.description: Demonstrates how to edit a PDF completely in memory by loading it from a MemoryStream, rotating a page with PdfPageEditor, and saving the result to another MemoryStream.

rotate-page-2-pdf-90-degrees.title: Rotate Second Page of PDF by 90 Degrees
rotate-page-2-pdf-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify a second page exists, rotate that page 90° clockwise, and save the modified document.

rotate-specific-pdf-pages.title: Rotate Specific PDF Pages by 180 Degrees
rotate-specific-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to rotate selected pages (3, 5, and 7) of a PDF document by 180° using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-specific-pdf-page.title: Rotate Page Four by 180 Degrees Using PdfPageEditor
rotate-specific-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to rotate the fourth page of a PDF document by 180 degrees using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

retrieve-pdf-page-size.title: Get Size of a PDF Page Using Aspose.Pdf
retrieve-pdf-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with PdfPageEditor, retrieve the dimensions of a specific page using GetPageSize, and log the width and height.

retrieve-page-rotation.title: Get Page Rotation Angle Using PdfPageEditor
retrieve-page-rotation.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with PdfPageEditor and retrieve the rotation angle of a specific page (page 4) using the GetPageRotation method.

resize-page-six-to-letter-size.title: Set Page Six to Letter Size Using Aspose.Pdf
resize-page-six-to-letter-size.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, verify it has at least six pages, and change the size of page six to the Letter format (612 × 792 points) using Aspose.Pdf's SetPageSize method.

set-page-zoom-to-150-percent.title: Set Page Zoom Using PdfPageEditor
set-page-zoom-to-150-percent.description: Shows how to apply a 150 % zoom to the third page of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

zoom-even-pages-pdf.title: Scale Even PDF Pages by 1.2 Zoom
zoom-even-pages-pdf.description: Shows how to apply a 1.2× zoom factor to all even-numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

add-fade-transition-to-pdf-page.title: Apply Fade Transition to First PDF Page
add-fade-transition-to-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to add a 2‑second Fade (Dissolve) transition to the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

apply-dissolve-transition-to-pdf-page.title: Apply Dissolve Transition to PDF Page
apply-dissolve-transition-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to set a Dissolve page transition with a 3‑second duration on a specific page using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

set-display-duration-page-five.title: Set Page Display Duration in PDF
set-display-duration-page-five.description: Shows how to set the display duration of a specific PDF page (page 5) to five seconds using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

align-page-two-left.title: Left Align Content of PDF Page Using PdfPageEditor
align-page-two-left.description: Demonstrates how to left‑justify the content of a specific PDF page (page 2) using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor and its HorizontalAlignment property.

align-page-three-vertically-top.title: Align Page 3 Vertically to Top
align-page-three-vertically-top.description: Shows how to use PdfPageEditor to align the content of page 3 to the top of the page in a PDF document.

resize-pdf-pages-content-10-percent-marg.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with 10% Margin
resize-pdf-pages-content-10-percent-marg.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.ResizeContents to add a uniform 10% margin around the contents of every page in a PDF document.

batch-rotate-first-page-pdfs.title: Batch Rotate First Page of PDFs
batch-rotate-first-page-pdfs.description: Shows how to loop through a directory of PDF files, rotate the first page of each document by 90 degrees clockwise with Aspose.Pdf, and save the modified files to an output folder.

batch-convert-pdfs-to-a4.title: Batch Resize PDFs to A4 Page Size
batch-convert-pdfs-to-a4.description: Shows how to process all PDF files in a folder, load each with Aspose.Pdf, change every page's dimensions to A4, and save the resized documents with a new name.

rotate-and-resize-pdf-page-to-letter.title: Rotate and Resize PDF Page to Letter Size
rotate-and-resize-pdf-page-to-letter.description: Demonstrates how to rotate the third page of a PDF by 90 degrees and change its size to Letter dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-zoom-to-non-consecutive-pdf-pages.title: Select Non-Consecutive PDF Pages and Apply Common Zoom
apply-zoom-to-non-consecutive-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract specific non‑consecutive pages from a PDF, combine them into a new document, and apply a uniform zoom factor to all resulting pages using Aspose.Pdf.

set-page-transition-duration-for-selecte.title: Set Page Transition Duration for a Range of PDF Pages
set-page-transition-duration-for-selecte.description: Demonstrates how to select a range of pages in a PDF and apply a one‑second fade transition using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

rotate-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.title: Rotate PDF Page Using PdfPageEditor
rotate-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.description: Demonstrates rotating a specific page of a PDF file by setting the Rotation property of Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to an allowed angle (0, 90, 180, or 270) and saving the modified document.

handle-invalid-rotation-value.title: Rotate PDF Page with Validation and Error Handling
handle-invalid-rotation-value.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a specific PDF page using Aspose.Pdf while validating the page number and rotation angle, and handling possible runtime exceptions.

create-contentsresizeparameters-with-uni.title: Set Uniform Margins for PDF Content Resize
create-contentsresizeparameters-with-uni.description: This example shows how to create a ContentsResizeParameters object with a 5‑point margin on all sides, which can be passed to PdfFileEditor.ResizeContents to adjust PDF page content.

apply-different-zoom-levels-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply Different Zoom Levels to PDF Pages and Convert to TIFF
apply-different-zoom-levels-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates iterating through each PDF page, applying a unique zoom factor with PdfPageEditor, and converting the zoom‑adjusted page to a TIFF image using PdfConverter.

apply-fade-transition-to-all-pdf-pages.title: Apply Fade Transition to All PDF Pages
apply-fade-transition-to-all-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to set a Fade page transition for every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

assign-page-transitions-by-content.title: Set Individual Page Transitions in PDF
assign-page-transitions-by-content.description: Shows how to assign different transition effects to specific PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade.

set-page-display-duration-by-word-count.title: Set Page Transition Duration Based on Word Count
set-page-display-duration-by-word-count.description: Shows how to calculate a display duration for each PDF page proportional to its word count and apply it as a page transition using Aspose.Pdf.

chain-page-rotation-size-zoom-modificati.title: Rotate, Resize and Zoom PDF Pages
chain-page-rotation-size-zoom-modificati.description: Demonstrates how to chain multiple page modifications—rotation, size change, and a simulated zoom—on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then save the result.

reset-page-rotation-to-zero.title: Reset Page Rotation in PDF
reset-page-rotation-to-zero.description: Shows how to reset the rotation of page 6 in a PDF document to its default (0°) orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

revert-pdf-page-size-to-original.title: Revert PDF Page Size to Original Dimensions
revert-pdf-page-size-to-original.description: Demonstrates how to store the original width and height of a PDF page, change its size, and then revert it back before saving the document.

audit-pdf-page-dimensions-rotation.title: Audit PDF Page Dimensions and Rotation Before and After Editing
audit-pdf-page-dimensions-rotation.description: Demonstrates how to log each page's width, height, and rotation angle before and after applying a 90° clockwise rotation to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

apply-horizontal-alignment-to-pdf-pages.title: Left‑justify Text on All PDF Pages
apply-horizontal-alignment-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to use PdfPageEditor to iterate through each page of a PDF, set the HorizontalAlignment of every TextFragment to left, and save the modified document.

apply-vertical-alignment-to-selected-pdf.title: Apply Vertical Alignment to Selected PDF Pages
apply-vertical-alignment-to-selected-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to align specific pages of a PDF to the top using PdfPageEditor’s VerticalAlignmentType property.

set-boxout-transition-on-pdf-page.title: Apply BoxOut Transition to PDF Page
set-boxout-transition-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to set a BoxOut page transition with a three‑second duration on a specific page of a PDF document.

set-cover-transition-on-pdf-page.title: Set Cover Transition on PDF Page
set-cover-transition-on-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to apply a Cover page transition with a 1‑second duration to a specific page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-zoom-of-page-to-75-percent.title: Set Page Zoom to 75% Using PdfPageEditor
set-zoom-of-page-to-75-percent.description: Demonstrates how to change the zoom factor of a specific PDF page (page 5) to 75% using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor and save the modified document.

set-zoom-on-specific-pdf-page.title: Set Zoom on Specific PDF Page
set-zoom-on-specific-pdf-page.description: Shows how to apply a 2.0 (200 %) zoom to page 7 of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

resize-pdf-page-contents-negative-margin.title: Shrink PDF Page Content by 5% Using PdfPageEditor
resize-pdf-page-contents-negative-margin.description: Demonstrates how to uniformly shrink the contents of every page in a PDF by applying a 5 % zoom using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

add-20-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Add 20% Margin to PDF Pages
add-20-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to increase each PDF page's size and add a uniform 20% whitespace margin around the existing content using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-pdf-pages-to-landscape.title: Convert PDF Pages to Landscape Orientation
convert-pdf-pages-to-landscape.description: Demonstrates how to change each page of a PDF from portrait to A4 landscape by adjusting the PageInfo width, height, and orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

convert-portrait-to-landscape.title: Convert Portrait PDF Pages to Landscape and Verify Dimensions
convert-portrait-to-landscape.description: Loads a PDF, swaps width and height of portrait pages, rotates their content to landscape, saves the result, and then prints the final page dimensions for verification.

rotate-pdf-page-180-preserve-transitions.title: Rotate PDF Page 180 Degrees While Preserving Transition
rotate-pdf-page-180-preserve-transitions.description: The example loads a PDF, checks that the specified page already has a transition effect using PdfPageEditor, rotates the page by 180 degrees, and saves the modified document, keeping the existing transition.

resize-and-rotate-pdf-page.title: Resize and Rotate PDF Page by 90 Degrees
resize-and-rotate-pdf-page.description: Shows how to shrink a PDF page, adjust its content margins to preserve layout, and then rotate the page 90 degrees clockwise using Aspose.Pdf.

incremental-update-pdf-text-annotation.title: Incremental Update PDF with Annotation
incremental-update-pdf-text-annotation.description: Demonstrates copying a PDF, opening it via a read/write stream, adding a text annotation to the first page, and saving using incremental update mode to preserve the original file structure.

edit-pdf-pages-save-new-file.title: Create Backup and Add Text Stamp to PDF
edit-pdf-pages-save-new-file.description: Demonstrates how to copy a PDF for backup, load the original with Aspose.Pdf, add a text stamp to the first page, and save the edited version as a new file.

set-page-display-duration-for-pdf-slides.title: Set Display Duration for PDF Slideshow Pages
set-page-display-duration-for-pdf-slides.description: Shows how to assign a display duration to each page of a PDF using PdfPageEditor, enabling automatic slideshow playback.

set-split-page-transition.title: Set Split Transition on PDF Page
set-split-page-transition.description: Demonstrates applying a Split page transition with a 2‑second duration to the third page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

disable-page-transition-animation.title: Disable Page Transition Animation on PDF Page 6
disable-page-transition-animation.description: Shows how to set the transition duration to zero for a specific PDF page, disabling any page transition animation using Aspose.Pdf.

set-sequential-page-transitions.title: Apply Different Page Transitions Sequentially in a PDF
set-sequential-page-transitions.description: Shows how to assign various transition effects to individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade and save the modified document.

set-page-zoom-to-100-percent.title: Set Default Zoom for All PDF Pages
set-page-zoom-to-100-percent.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to apply a 100% zoom (scale) to every page of a PDF before saving.

set-zoom-on-odd-pages.title: Apply Zoom to Odd Pages in PDF
set-zoom-on-odd-pages.description: Shows how to set a 1.2 zoom factor on all odd‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

set-zoom-on-even-pdf-pages.title: Apply 80% Zoom to Even PDF Pages and Export as PNG
set-zoom-on-even-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to set a zoom factor of 0.8 on all even‑numbered pages of a PDF using PdfPageEditor, then render each page to PNG images with PngDevice.

resize-specific-pdf-pages-to-us-letter.title: Resize Specific PDF Pages to US Letter Size
resize-specific-pdf-pages-to-us-letter.description: Shows how to change the page size of selected pages in a PDF to US Letter dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

set-last-page-size-a5.title: Set Last PDF Page to A5 Size
set-last-page-size-a5.description: Loads a PDF, changes the dimensions of the final page to A5, and saves the modified document, enabling a compact booklet format.

rotate-every-third-pdf-page.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page to Landscape
rotate-every-third-pdf-page.description: Loads a PDF, rotates each third page by 270 degrees to achieve landscape orientation, and saves the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

retrieve-page-size-after-rotation.title: Retrieve Effective Page Size After Rotation
retrieve-page-size-after-rotation.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then obtain the effective page dimensions that reflect the new orientation.

retrieve-verify-page-rotation-after-resi.title: Retrieve and Verify Page Rotation After Resizing PDF
retrieve-verify-page-rotation-after-resi.description: The example loads a PDF, reads the rotation of the first page, changes the page size, saves the document, and then confirms that the rotation value remains unchanged.

apply-custom-page-transitions.title: Apply Custom Page Transitions Based on Index
apply-custom-page-transitions.description: Shows how to assign different transition effects to each PDF page using PdfPageEditor, varying the type and duration according to the page index, and then save the modified document.

set-per-page-display-duration.title: Set Per-Page Display Duration in PDF
set-per-page-display-duration.description: Shows how to assign a different display duration to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor, increasing the duration by one second for each subsequent page.

center-page-content-horizontally.title: Center Text Horizontally on PDF Page 2
center-page-content-horizontally.description: Shows how to load a PDF, create a TextFragment, set its HorizontalAlignment to Center, and add it to the second page using Aspose.Pdf.

vertically-center-page-content.title: Align Page Content Vertically to Middle
vertically-center-page-content.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf.Facades PdfContentEditor to align the content of page 3 to the middle vertically, noting the requirement for a newer library version.

set-horizontal-alignment-and-zoom-on-pag.title: Render PDF Page 4 as TIFF with Zoom
set-horizontal-alignment-and-zoom-on-pag.description: Shows how to convert a single PDF page (page 4) to a TIFF image while applying a zoom effect by increasing the rendering resolution using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter.

add-10-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Resize PDF Pages with Uniform Margin
add-10-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to apply a uniform 80% zoom to all pages of a PDF using PdfPageEditor, creating a 10% margin on each side for printing.

batch-set-fade-transition-pdf-slideshow.title: Batch Apply Fade Transition to PDF Pages
batch-set-fade-transition-pdf-slideshow.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF and use PdfPageEditor to set a Fade slide transition with a two‑second duration on every page, then save the result.

rotate-pdf-pages-and-save.title: Rotate PDF Page Within a Stream
rotate-pdf-pages-and-save.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from any seek‑able stream, rotating a specific page using Aspose.Pdf, and writing the modified PDF back to the original stream (with fallback for non‑seekable streams).

resize-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.title: Modify PDF Page Size from Byte Array
resize-pdf-pages-using-pdfpageeditor.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, updates each page's width, height, and orientation via the PageInfo object, and saves the modified document to a new file.

dispose-pdfpageeditor-properly.title: Rotate First PDF Page with Proper Disposal
dispose-pdfpageeditor-properly.description: The example loads a PDF, rotates the first page 90 degrees clockwise, saves the result to a new file, and uses a using block to dispose the Document and release file handles.

set-custom-page-size-with-pdfpageeditor.title: Set Custom Page Size for PDF Pages
set-custom-page-size-with-pdfpageeditor.description: Shows how to change the width and height of all pages in a PDF to non‑standard dimensions using Aspose.Pdf's PageInfo properties.

set-page-transitions-fade-boxout-cover.title: Set Page Transitions (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) in PDF
set-page-transitions-fade-boxout-cover.description: Demonstrates applying different page transition effects (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) to individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

set-pdf-page-zoom-using-double-precision.title: Render PDF Page to PNG with Custom Zoom
set-pdf-page-zoom-using-double-precision.description: Demonstrates how to render the first page of a PDF to a PNG image using a double‑precision zoom factor by converting it to DPI. The example uses Aspose.Pdf to load the document and apply the desired resolution.

set-slide-display-duration-pdf-presentat.title: Set Slide Duration for PDF Presentation
set-slide-display-duration-pdf-presentat.description: Demonstrates how to assign per‑page display durations and a fade transition to a PDF, turning it into a presentation using Aspose.Pdf.

set-horizontal-alignment-pdf.title: Set Page Horizontal Alignment Using PdfPageEditor
set-horizontal-alignment-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it to PdfPageEditor, set the horizontal alignment (left, center, or right) for selected pages, and save the modified document.

resize-pdf-contents-uniform-margin.title: Resize PDF Pages with Uniform Margins
resize-pdf-contents-uniform-margin.description: Shows how to uniformly scale the content of all PDF pages so that a fixed margin is kept on every side, using Aspose.Pdf.Document for size information and PdfPageEditor for scaling.

resize-pdf-contents-top-bottom-margins.title: Resize PDF Contents with Custom Top and Bottom Margins
resize-pdf-contents-top-bottom-margins.description: Demonstrates how to add different top and bottom margins to a PDF by using PdfFileEditor.ContentsResizeParameters and the ResizeContents method.

rotate-and-reset-pdf-page-orientation.title: Rotate PDF Page and Reset Orientation
rotate-and-reset-pdf-page-orientation.description: Shows how to rotate a specific page of a PDF by 90° clockwise and then restore it to its original orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

change-pdf-page-size-and-undo.title: Change PDF Page Size and Undo to Original Dimensions
change-pdf-page-size-and-undo.description: Demonstrates how to record original page dimensions, apply a custom size to all pages, save the modified PDF, and then revert the pages back to their original sizes to test undo functionality.

log-pdf-page-property-changes.title: Audit PDF Page Modifications (Rotation & Size)
log-pdf-page-property-changes.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, logging original page rotation and size, applying a 90‑degree rotation and resizing a page to A4, then saving the document while writing an audit log.

report-pdf-page-properties-before-after.title: Generate PDF Page Property Report and Apply Size, Rotation, and Zoom Edits
report-pdf-page-properties-before-after.description: The example reads each page of a PDF, records its size, rotation, and zoom, then enlarges the page, rotates it, and applies a zoom factor, finally writing a detailed report and saving the edited document.

rotate-pages-encrypted-pdf.title: Modify Encrypted PDF: Delete, Rotate, and Append Blank Page
rotate-pages-encrypted-pdf.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF by providing a password, delete the first page, rotate the new first page, and add a blank page at the end using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-preserve-annotations.title: Resize PDF Pages While Preserving Annotations
resize-pdf-pages-preserve-annotations.description: Demonstrates how to change the width and height of every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping all existing annotations, form fields, and links intact.

rotate-pdf-pages-preserve-form-fields.title: Rotate PDF Pages While Preserving Form Fields
rotate-pdf-pages-preserve-form-fields.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, rotating each page 90° clockwise, and saving the document while keeping existing form fields and their values intact.

apply-transition-to-odd-pages.title: Apply Fade Transition to Odd Pages in PDF
apply-transition-to-odd-pages.description: Shows how to apply a Fade page transition only to odd‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

set-display-duration-even-pages.title: Set Display Duration for Even Pages in PDF
set-display-duration-even-pages.description: Shows how to assign a custom display duration (slide interval) to even‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

zoom-pdf-pages-with-images.title: Zoom PDF Pages Containing Images
zoom-pdf-pages-with-images.description: Demonstrates how to detect pages that contain image objects in a PDF and apply a zoom factor only to those pages using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-contents-on-text-pages.title: Resize PDF Pages Containing Text Only
resize-contents-on-text-pages.description: The example loads a PDF, identifies pages that contain any text using TextAbsorber, and applies a uniform scaling factor only to those pages with PdfPageEditor. Pages without text are left unchanged.

combine-page-rotation-zoom-presentation.title: Rotate and Zoom PDF Pages for Presentation Transitions
combine-page-rotation-zoom-presentation.description: Demonstrates how to apply a 90° clockwise rotation and a 150% zoom to all pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor, enabling dynamic slide transitions.

set-custom-a4-landscape-page-size.title: Set PDF Pages to A4 Landscape Size
set-custom-a4-landscape-page-size.description: Shows how to change each page of a PDF to A4 landscape dimensions by setting PageInfo.Width, Height, and IsLandscape using Aspose.Pdf.

set-pdf-page-size-to-letter-portrait.title: Set PDF Page Size to Letter Portrait
set-pdf-page-size-to-letter-portrait.description: Shows how to resize each page of a PDF to the standard Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11") in portrait orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-landscape-pdf-pages.title: Rotate PDF Pages Based on Custom Metadata
rotate-landscape-pdf-pages.description: The example reads a custom PDF property that lists page numbers needing landscape orientation, parses the list, rotates those pages 90° clockwise, and saves the result.

set-page-transition-duration-based-on-ti.title: Set Page Transition Duration Based on Title Length
set-page-transition-duration-based-on-ti.description: Demonstrates how to assign a transition to each PDF page and adjust its duration according to the length of a custom title stored in the document's Info dictionary.

adjust-page-zoom-based-on-word-count.title: Adjust PDF Page Zoom Based on Word Count
adjust-page-zoom-based-on-word-count.description: The example loads a PDF, extracts the plain text of each page to count words, and then scales the page dimensions with a higher zoom factor for pages that contain fewer words. The modified document is saved with adjusted zoom levels.

batch-adjust-pdf-page-size.title: Batch Set Individual Page Sizes in PDFs
batch-adjust-pdf-page-size.description: Demonstrates how to process all PDF files in a folder, iterate through each page, assign different page dimensions (e.g., A4 for odd pages, Letter for even pages) using Aspose.Pdf, and save the modified documents.

extract-rotate-selected-pdf-pages.title: Extract and Rotate Selected PDF Pages
extract-rotate-selected-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract specific pages from a PDF, rotate each extracted page, and save the result as a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-pdfs-with-uniform-margins.title: Merge PDFs with Uniform Page Size and Margins
merge-pdfs-with-uniform-margins.description: Loads two PDFs, resizes each page to a common A4 size, applies consistent margins, and concatenates the adjusted PDFs into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-and-split-pdf-into-chapters.title: Resize PDF Pages to Uniform Size and Split into Chapters
resize-and-split-pdf-into-chapters.description: Shows how to resize all pages of a PDF to a uniform A4 size using Aspose.Pdf.Document, then split the resized document into separate chapter PDFs with PdfFileEditor.Extract.

create-pdf-slideshow-with-page-transitio.title: Create PDF Slideshow with Page Transitions
create-pdf-slideshow-with-page-transitio.description: Demonstrates how to set page transition effects and display durations for all pages using PdfPageEditor to generate a PDF slideshow.

center-page-content-set-display-duration.title: Center Align Page and Set Display Duration in PDF
center-page-content-set-display-duration.description: Shows how to center‑align the content of a specific PDF page and set its automatic display duration using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-5-percent-margins-and-print-pdf.title: Add 5% Margin to PDF Pages
add-5-percent-margins-and-print-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to enlarge each PDF page by 5 % to create a white margin and then scale the original content down so it remains centered using Aspose.Pdf.

add-15-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.title: Apply 15% Margin Resize to Selected PDF Pages for Booklet Layout
add-15-percent-margins-to-pdf-pages.description: Loads a PDF, selects specific pages, applies a 15 % margin on all sides to improve readability for booklet printing, and saves the modified document.

rotate-pdf-pages-to-landscape-brochure.title: Rotate PDF Pages to Landscape for Brochure Printing
rotate-pdf-pages-to-landscape-brochure.description: Shows how to rotate each page of a PDF to landscape orientation and resize it to standard A4 landscape dimensions for brochure printing using Aspose.Pdf.

change-pdf-page-size-to-a3.title: Resize PDF Pages to A3 Size
change-pdf-page-size-to-a3.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set each page's dimensions to A3, and save the modified document.

set-pdf-page-zoom-preview-final.title: Render PDF Pages to PNG Preview and Final Images
set-pdf-page-zoom-preview-final.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, renders each page to PNG at two zoom levels (0.5 preview using 72 DPI and 1.0 final using 144 DPI), and saves the images to separate directories.

hybrid-content-resize-mixed-margins.title: Resize PDF Pages Using Hybrid Percentage and Absolute Margins
hybrid-content-resize-mixed-margins.description: Demonstrates how to create a ContentsResizeParameters instance with mixed percentage and absolute margins and apply it to resize the contents of PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

apply-page-transitions-by-index.title: Apply Rotating Page Transitions with PdfPageEditor
apply-page-transitions-by-index.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, iterating through its pages, and assigning different transition effects (Fade, Split, Wipe) to each page using PdfPageEditor based on the page index modulo three.

apply-rotation-size-zoom-to-pdf-pages.title: Rotate, Resize, and Zoom PDF Pages
apply-rotation-size-zoom-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to rotate all pages, set a custom page size, and apply a uniform zoom factor to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and the PdfPageEditor facade.

resize-pages-two-and-four.title: Resize Specific PDF Pages Using PdfPageEditor
resize-pages-two-and-four.description: Loads a PDF, selects pages 2 and 4, scales their content with a zoom factor using PdfPageEditor, and saves the modified document.

resize-pdf-content-uniform-15-percent-ma.title: Resize PDF Content with Uniform 15% Margins
resize-pdf-content-uniform-15-percent-ma.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor to resize PDF page contents by applying a uniform 15% margin on all sides.

get-pdf-page-size-with-error-handling.title: Get PDF Page Size with Error Handling
get-pdf-page-size-with-error-handling.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor to retrieve the size of specific PDF pages and safely handle requests for non‑existent pages using try‑catch blocks.

apply-page-adjustments-from-json.title: Apply Page Adjustments from JSON Config to PDFs
apply-page-adjustments-from-json.description: Shows how to read a JSON configuration file and programmatically rotate, resize, and set background colors for specific PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.
